name: donwells-cue-monorepo
description: DonWells Cue — open-source audio playback for live sound operators. Monorepo root: client (Vue/Electron) + server (C++ audio engine).

scripts.build:electron: npm run server:build && npm run build:client:electron
scripts.check:client: node scripts/check-live-safety.js && node client/electron/path-capabilities.test.js && npm run test:file-formats --workspace=client && node scripts/spotify-import-reliability.test.js && npm run test:video-output --workspace=client && npm run test:one-shots --workspace=client && npm run test:youtube-import --workspace=client && npm run test:playback-safety --workspace=client && npm run test:local-auth --workspace=client && npm run test:operator-manual --workspace=client
